entities.name: Kyōko Nagatsuka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kyōko Nagatsuka is a Japanese former professional tennis player. She achieved a career-high ranking of world No. 28 on 14 August 1995. In doubles, she reached as high as No. 31 in June 1995.
